note: Verify pass 2026-11-02. One tree verified (kos_001, in data/research/kos-verified.json). Searches in English and Greek found no other named old tree on the island, no Dodecanese Monuments of Nature list reachable, and OSM/Nominatim holds only the Hippocrates plane as a tree node. The place does not reach four trees from this pass. leads.name: Cypress and pine grove at the Asklepieion
leads.reason: no photo or exact pin in reach; no source gives an age or an individual tree. Sources only describe a conifer grove (about 4 km from Kos town) echoing the ancient sacred grove; the living trees are undated.

leads.name: Plane trees and olives of the mountain villages (Zia, Pyli, Asfendiou)
leads.reason: no photo or exact pin in reach; Greek and English searches returned nothing about any named old tree there. Needs a local source (Municipality of Kos, Forest Service Dodecanese) or a reader.

leads.name: Seed-grown descendants of the Hippocrates plane on Kos
leads.reason: no source found naming one on the island; not checked beyond search.
